summary.text: Steve Cohen is the Republican candidate for CA-50 who advanced from the June 2026 primary with 39.8% of the vote, behind Scott Peters (48.1%). KPBS describes him as a former news director. Ballotpedia records no completed Candidate Connection survey or biography for him.

paragraphs.text: KPBS describes him as a former news director and as the Republican challenger to Rep. Scott Peters in the 50th District.
